targets.authors: Brady, T. F., Shafer-Skelton, A., & Alvarez, G. A.
targets.title: Global ensemble texture representations are critical to rapid scene perception.
targets.evidence_quote: Because of its importance for the understanding of both object and scene perception, we undertook a registered replication attempt of Experiments 2 B and 3B from Brady et al. ( 2017 ), whose results we report in Experiment 2 .
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, we were unable to replicate the critical conditions from Brady et al. ( 2017 ). Thus, we do not find sufficient evidence for a privileged role of global ensemble statistics for scene over object perception.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall conclusion explicitly states failure to replicate the critical finding, overriding individual priming agreements. The authors acknowledge an inconclusive scene condition but still give a substantive overall failure verdict.

reasoning: Full article title and all three authors match. The pilot and preregistered experiment retest one published original; within-paper pilot replication adds no independent original.
